title: Staining of Single-Cell Suspensions for scMEP Mass Cytometry Analysis
author: Felix J Hartmann
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bntnmeme
materials: Prepare surface antibody mastermix. Note: Antibodies were titrated for 3 million cells, if more cells are to be used, scale antibody amounts accordingly (i.e. use 2x antibodies for up to 6 million cells). Combine all surface antibodies and supplement volume to a total of 50 µL with Cell Staining Medium (CSM: PBS + 0.5% BSA + 0.02% sodium azide). If antibody volume succeeds 50 µL , no CSM addition is needed.

Prepare intracellular antibody mastermix. Note: Antibodies were titrated for 3 million cells, if more cells are to be used, scale antibody amounts accordingly (i.e. use 2x antibodies for up to 6 million cells). Combine all intracellular antibodies and supplement volume to a total of 50 µL with CSM. If antibody volume succeeds 50 µL , no CSM addition is needed.

steps.title: Prepare Single Cell Suspensions
steps.instruction: Prepare single cell suspensions in FACS tubes following the protocol by Felix J Hartmann.

steps.title: Perform Palladium-Based Barcoding
steps.instruction: Perform palladium-based barcoding as described in the specified protocol.

steps.title: First Antibody Staining
steps.instruction: Add antibody mastermix to cells and incubate.

substeps.instruction: Mix carefully by pipetting up and down, followed by a gentle vortex
Incubate for 00:30:00 at Room temperature

steps.title: Wash Cells
steps.instruction: Wash the cells using Cell Staining Medium (CSM).

substeps.instruction: Add 2 mL of CSM and mix carefully
Centrifuge at 600 x g (reduce to 300g for live cells) at Room temperature for 5 minutes
Aspirate supernatant and dissolve pellet by flicking tube or vortexing

steps.title: Fix Cells
steps.instruction: Fix antibodies onto cells using paraformaldehyde (PFA).

substeps.instruction: Dilute 16% PFA (Fisher Scientific #50-980-487) to 1.6% in PBS
Add 1 mL of freshly diluted 1.6% PFA to loosened cells and mix well
Incubate for 00:10:00 at Room temperature

steps.title: Wash Fixed Cells
steps.instruction: Wash the fixed cells with CSM.

substeps.instruction: Add 3 mL (or maximum vessel capacity) of CSM
Centrifuge at 600 x g, 4 °C, for 5 minutes
Aspirate supernatant and loosen cell pellet by flicking and vortexing
While vortexing cells, add 1 mL of pre-cooled (4 °C) MeOH drop-wise
Immediately transfer cells on ice and incubate for 00:10:00

steps.title: Wash Permeabilized Cells
steps.instruction: Perform two consecutive washes with CSM.

substeps.instruction: Wash 1: Add 3 mL (or maximum vessel capacity) of CSM, centrifuge at 600 x g, 4 °C, for 5 minutes, aspirate supernatant, and loosen pellet
Wash 2: Add 3 mL (or maximum vessel capacity) of CSM, centrifuge at 600 x g, Room temperature, for 5 minutes, aspirate supernatant, and loosen pellet

steps.title: Second Antibody Staining
steps.instruction: Add antibody mastermix to cells and incubate.

substeps.instruction: Mix carefully by pipetting up and down, followed by a gentle vortex
Incubate for 01:00:00 at Room temperature
Flick tube carefully after approximately 00:30:00 to ensure proper mixing
Add 2 mL of CSM, mix carefully, and centrifuge at 600 x g, Room temperature, for 5 minutes
Aspirate supernatant and loosen pellet

steps.title: DNA Intercalation
steps.instruction: Stain cells with Rhodium DNA intercalator.

substeps.instruction: Prepare intercalation solution: 1.6% PFA in PBS + 0.5 µM of Intercalator-Rh (Fluidigm #201103A)
Add 1 mL of intercalation solution for each 10 million cells
Incubate either 00:20:00 at Room temperature or Overnight at 4 °C

steps.title: Final Washing Sequence
steps.instruction: Perform a series of washes to remove unbound dye.

substeps.instruction: CSM Wash: Add 3 mL (or maximum vessel capacity) of CSM, centrifuge at 600 x g, Room temperature, for 5 minutes, aspirate supernatant, and loosen pellet
First ddH2O Wash: Add 3 mL (or maximum vessel capacity) of ddH2O, centrifuge at 600 x g, Room temperature, for 5 minutes, aspirate supernatant, and loosen pellet
Second ddH2O Wash: Add 3 mL (or maximum vessel capacity) of ddH2O, centrifuge at 600 x g, Room temperature, for 5 minutes, aspirate supernatant, and loosen pellet

steps.title: Calibration and Acquisition
steps.instruction: Add calibration beads and acquire data.

substeps.instruction: Dilute EQ beads (Fluidigm #201078) 1:10 in ddH2O
Add 1 mL of diluted beads per 1 million cells
Filter cells through a cell strainer and acquire on CyTOF
